To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optical parameters were found to increase by increasing the HPC content in PVA/ HPC blend and the band gap energy increases with the HCP contents.
the addition of HPC to PVA increases the optical band gap and the band tail width of the samples.
the optical parameters and the FTIR results of the PVA/ HPC blends before and after fast neutrons irradiation were studied and discussed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of HPC on the PVA films and the effect of fast neutron on the prepared blends.
the optical characterization of PVA/HPC films before and after exposure to fast neutrons.
the optical properties and the chemical structure of the PVA/HPC blends before and after irradiated with fast neutrons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the optical band gaps and the FTIR data are sensitive and effective tools for monitoring the effect of HPC and fast neutrons.
the increase in HPC contents and fast neutron irradiation have the same effect on the optical and FTIR parameters.
the optical properties and FTIR spectra of the PVA/ HPC blends are strongly dependent on the weight percent of HCP and fast neutrons irradiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optical parameters of the prepared PVA/ HPC blends were changed with the HPC concentration as well as with the fast neutron irradiation.
the optical properties of the prepared films were found to be affected by the addition of HPC to PVA as well as the fast neutron irradiation.
the optical parameters and the chemical bonds of PVA/HPC films were affected by the addition of HPC as well as the fast neutron irradiation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of HPC to PVA increases the optical band gap and the band tail width of PVA.
the optical properties and the chemical bonds of PVC/HPC blends are affected by fast neutron irradiation.
the optical properties of PVA/ HPC blends can be tailored by the addition of HPC and by fast neutron irradiation.
